contains: Reports cumulative confluent mucositis 53% (6 fx/wk) vs 33% (5 fx/wk), percentages only, in 1420 patients total (per-arm denominators not given). Qualitative duration. No feeding tube or treatment-break-for-toxicity data by arm. Scale: DAHANCA morbidity scheme.
missing: Per-arm counts/denominators for confluent mucositis; grade>=3 on a standard scale; feeding tube; breaks.
reasons_not_primary: Usable with percentage only (counts not derivable). 47% glottic (small-field) patients; nimorazole in non-glottic patients (both arms). Overlaps Lyhne 2015 (DAHANCA 6 subset).

contains: Table 2 gives confluent mucositis 45/441 (6 fx) vs 22/439 (5 fx) and tube feeding 231/441 vs 198/439; qualitative statement that mucositis persisted longer with acceleration (data not shown).
missing: Scoring scale and assessment schedule not stated; no grade>=3 on named scale; no duration numbers; no toxicity-related breaks.
reasons_not_primary: Usable. Caveat: confluent mucositis rate (5-10%) is implausibly low vs other trials, suggesting under-recording in resource-limited centres; Co-60 used at some centres.

contains: Three-arm trial; Table 5 gives RTOG grade 3-4 and WHO grade 3, 4 mucositis counts per arm with denominators; feeding tube during treatment; Table 3 temporary RT interruptions (cause unspecified).
missing: Assessment frequency; duration of mucositis; breaks specifically due to toxicity (only definite stops for toxic effects 2/4/1).
reasons_not_primary: Two arms have concurrent carboplatin-5FU chemotherapy with different planned cycles (3x4d vs 2x5d), so the conventional-CRT vs accelerated-RT-CT contrast is confounded by chemotherapy dose; only very-accelerated arm is RT alone. No RT-alone conventional control.

contains: Confluent mucositis at end of RT 70% (AF) vs 56% (CF) as percentages only; confluent mucositis persisting at 8 weeks post-RT 6 vs 2 (Table 4); treatment interruptions for acute morbidity 14/196 vs 7/199 (Table 3). Dische scale, weekly scoring.
missing: Counts and denominators for peak confluent mucositis; feeding tube data; duration.
reasons_not_primary: Small-field larynx-only N0 trial (mostly T1-T2 glottic, ~70% larynx-only fields): mucosal volume much smaller than other trials. Peak count not derivable.

contains: Table 4 RTOG/EORTC mucous membrane grades per arm (grade 3-4: 51/143 CB vs 27/142 conv); Ryle's tube 4/143 in CB arm only; treatment stopped for mucositis 2 vs 3.
missing: Feeding tube for conventional arm; duration of mucositis; temporary breaks for toxicity.
reasons_not_primary: Text/table discrepancy for conventional grade 3 count (23 vs 27). Single institution, Co-60/2D. Otherwise usable.

contains: Table 4 peak Dische score categories per arm (50 CAIR / 49 control evaluated); severe CM 62% vs 26%; explicit zero tube feeding; one toxicity-related stop per arm; consequential late effects 5/23 CAIR at 2.0 Gy.
missing: Standard RTOG grade; numeric durations; separate acute counts by 2.0 vs 1.8 Gy era.
reasons_not_primary: Dose per fraction changed mid-trial (2.0 -> 1.8 Gy) in both arms, so each arm is a mixture of two schedules; acute counts not split by era. Weekend fractions to small fields only. Overlaps Skladowski 2006 and Maciejewski 1996 (same trial).

contains: Long-term update of CAIR-1 (same patients as 2000 report). Confluent mucositis (simplified score) 94% vs 53%, percentages only; duration of CM 4.2 vs 1.5 weeks; Fig 1 bar charts of max mucositis, supportive treatment, dysphagia, analgesia without numbers.
missing: Explicit denominators/counts; grade>=3 on standard scale.
reasons_not_primary: Duplicate of Skladowski 2000 trial - use one report per arm (2000 gives counts). Mixed 2.0/1.8 Gy fractions within arms.

contains: CAIR-2: two accelerated 1.8 Gy schedules with identical dose/OTT (7 fx in 7 days vs 7 fx in 5 days with Tue/Fri twice-daily). CM grade 3 89% vs 86% (percent only), CM duration 31 vs 29 days; dysphagia tube bar chart only.
missing: Acute-toxicity denominators; standard-scale grade; tube-feeding counts; breaks.
reasons_not_primary: Usable only as percentage; arms differ only in fraction spacing (twice-daily 6 h interval on 2 days vs weekend treatment), not dose/OTT, so contributes little contrast. Delivered OTT given as averages.

contains: Preliminary acute-toxicity report of first 44 CAIR-1 patients (all 2.0 Gy fractions): severe CM (>15) lasting >3 wk 48% vs 5%; Table 4 Dische categories at end of week 2 and end of treatment; healing timing; supportive treatment incl. parenteral nutrition 87% vs 43%.
missing: Per-patient maximum grade table; feeding tube counts (only 'parenteral nutrition' as part of supportive care); breaks (text implies arm A completed without breaks).
reasons_not_primary: Subset of CAIR-1 (Skladowski 2000/2006) - do not double count. Only 2.0 Gy era. Small n (44).

contains: Table 5 grade 3-4 mucosal toxicity per arm with denominators (70/154 CF vs 97/156 HF); qualitative persistence; Fig 3 weekly prevalence.
missing: Feeding tube; breaks due to toxicity; numeric duration.
reasons_not_primary: Both arms 4-week schedules; CF arm uses 2.55 Gy fractions (hypofractionated control). Usable.

contains: Secondary correlation analysis of EORTC 22791: grade 3 mucositis at end of treatment 49% (CF) vs 67% (HF) as percentages only; treatment prolongation >55 d by arm and T stage (mostly due to acute mucosal reactions); delivered median OTT 50 d both arms; duration of grade 3 in box plots.
missing: Clear denominators for acute endpoint; interfraction interval; feeding tube.
reasons_not_primary: Duplicate of EORTC 22791 main report (Horiot 1992) - use whichever has counts; denominators inconsistent (316/325/327).

contains: Main EORTC 22791 report: Table X peak objective mucosal reaction per arm (G3 diffuse 78/158 CF vs 108/162 HF), functional G4 oral alimentation impossible 17 vs 26, stops for functional reactions 7 vs 12.
missing: Duration of mucositis; explicit feeding tube.
reasons_not_primary: Usable; G3 on EORTC 3-grade objective scale = diffuse (confluent-type) mucositis. Some CF patients at 1.8 Gy/8 weeks. HF interfraction interval only 4-6 h.

contains: Table 4 grade 3-4 OMR and FMR during and 6 weeks after RT with denominators (OMR during: 123/245 CF vs 160/240 AF); oral alimentation impossible 13 vs 41; mean duration of grade 3-4 acute effects 2.7 vs 3.0 weeks; interruptions 47 vs 21 (cause unspecified).
missing: Feeding tube counts per se; cause-specific breaks.
reasons_not_primary: Usable. AF arm is a 3x/day split-course schedule with 4 h intervals (incomplete repair) - model must handle split and TID spacing. Mixed sites incl. nasopharynx; interstitial boosts in 16 patients.

contains: Four-arm trial; Table 3 worst acute RTOG mucous membrane grades per arm with analyzable N; delivered median dose/fractions/time per arm.
missing: Feeding tube; duration; breaks (except AFX-S planned split); scoring of grade 0/missing not separable.
reasons_not_primary: Usable. Denominator = analyzable patients (not explicitly those evaluated for toxicity). AFX-S has a planned 2-week split.

contains: Long-term report: Table 3 grade 3-5 mucositis/stomatitis <=90 d (141/361 vs 119/360); feeding tube prevalence before, at end, 1 y, 5 y (percent only); delivered dose/time and cisplatin cycles.
missing: Breaks for toxicity (only RT delivery days); interfraction interval; duration of mucositis.
reasons_not_primary: Chemoradiotherapy with different cisplatin cycles per arm (3 vs 2): RT-schedule contrast confounded; prophylactic/pre-existing feeding tubes. Earlier RTOG 0129 reports (Ang 2010) not in batch.

contains: Max mucositis grade 3+ (CTCAE 4.0) 190/373 HFX vs 208/380 NFX, with grade 4 counts; grade 3+ dysphagia composite (tube/TPN/hospitalization) 151/373 vs 158/380; prolongation >5 days 10% vs 18%; opioid use, weight loss.
missing: Mucositis split by chemo vs no chemo; duration; per-arm delivered OTT (supplement Fig E1 not read); how NFX 6th fraction delivered.
reasons_not_primary: Usable. 75% concurrent weekly cisplatin (balanced, stratified, 4 vs 5 courses); mixed 2D/IMRT-SIB (SIB changes dose per fraction to non-target mucosa). Control arm is the IAEA-ACC accelerated 6-fx/week schedule.
